notes.title: BrawlQuest 1.1.0
notes.content:
A new BrawlQuest update is now available! 

[h2]Content[/h2]
- New quest: Ooze Control
- Added ‘Exotic Mobs’
  - Every mob has a 1 in 10 chance of spawning as an exotic 
  - These have 3 times the HP and twice the attack 
  - Exotic Mobs give double XP, loot rolls are halved (IE a 5% item drop becomes a 10% item drop) and drop 1 “Crystal Fragment”
  - 10 Crystal Fragments can be crafted into 1 Old World Crystal
- All HP and mana potions now have a 2 minute cool-down, but give considerably more HP/mana (the idea here is that you should time your usage of them, and diversify item types)
- Fixed conversation triggers for Frightened Skeleton and Trainee Wizard

[h2]Balance[/h2]
I’ve done a big balance pass across all enemies and items. The aim of these has been to..

- Make melee more viable, without making mage less fun
- Make armour more effective and important 
- Make cool mounts cool again

It’d be a huge list to include here, so instead I’m just going to lis the ones that are important mechanically:
[h3]Armour[/h3]
- Armour now resists half your armour value to your max armour value (previously 1-armour value)
- There’s now a 25% chance of a “critical deflection” when your armour value is greater than the enemy’s attack. This will negate all damage for that tick. 

[h3]Character Points[/h3]
One of the reasons Mage is so strong is because you can altogether avoid taking damage in situations where even a Stoic might die quickly. To rectify this, I’ve boosted HP values depending on which class a player is:

[h4]Mage Order[/h4]
- Stamina increases HP by 5 for each point (previously 10)

[h4]Warrior Order[/h4]
- Stamina now increases HP by 15 for each point (previously 10)
- Strength now increases HP by 5 for each point (previously 0)

[h4]Stoic Order[/h4]
- Stamina now increases HP by 20 for each point (previously 10)
- Strength now increases HP by 5 for each point (previously 0)

[h4]Classless[/h4]
- Stamina increases HP by 10 for each point (same as before)
- Strength now increases HP by 5 for each point (previously 0)

[h3]Spells[/h3]
The focus of these changes is for spells to add interesting dynamics to fights for Mages that extend beyond them holding down left mouse. You’ll now need to pay attention to what spells are on/off cooldown, and use them appropriately. 

- Scroll of Intellect now increases INT by {INT} for 120 seconds in a 4m radius (previously 8)
- Scroll of Superior Intellect now increases INT by {INT * 2} for 120 seconds in an 8m radius (previously 25 for 30 seconds)
- Scroll of Fire now causes 1-{INT} damage in a 4m radius every second for 3 seconds (previously 1/2 {INT} to {INT} for 1 second)

[h5]Spell Cooldowns[/h5]
Soon there'll be an individual item cooldown to replace the existing global spell cooldown. This isn't live yet, but when it comes in the following spells will have the following cooldowns:

- Scroll of Intellect: 120 seconds
- Scroll of Superior Intellect: 120 seconds
- Scroll of Healing: 25 seconds
- Scroll of Good Fortune: 120 seconds
- Scroll of Fire: 14 seconds
- Scroll of Protection: 30 seconds
- Recovery: 10 seconds
- Whirlwind: 300 seconds
- Bone Hurting Juice: 30 seconds
- Scroll of Allied Protection: 30 seconds

[h3]Mage changes[/h3]
- Ranged attacks now have a radius of 2m (previously 3m)
- Ranged attacks no longer use mana

[h2]Misc[/h2]
- You’ll only be dismounted from attacks that deal > 5% of your total HP

[h2]Server[/h2]
- Separated content and user databases
- Further huge server efficiency improvements
- Fixed an issue that caused consumables with a quantity of 1 to not be removed from inventory on use

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]
- Your inventory items will explode into you on game start
- Receiving items after kills is slightly delayed

notes.title: BrawlQuest 1.0.4
notes.content:
It's time for another BrawlQuest update!

[h1]Content[/h1]
- Fishing now has a 10% chance of giving a random item (previously 1%)

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

- Achievements work again
- Fixed frame rate issues from world animations
- Fixed ‘mana_potion’ tab title on crafting UI

[h1]Misc[/h1]
- You can now press “e” to close the tutorial (this helps with SteamDeck where B is mapped to E)

- Added equip SFX to various mounts that didn’t have them
- You can now hear equip SFX of other player’s mounts
- Improved attack indicator reliability 
- Temporarily removed the US server (working on it! Although it shouldn’t really be necessary anymore anyway….)
… and some secrets :)

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
- Sometimes enemies are slower to react than they used to be
- Sometimes your entire inventory explodes around your body and re-enters you

notes.title: BrawlQuest 1.0.3
notes.content:
Well hello there! It’s bugged me for the longest time that this massive 100,000+ line of code project built by myself and Dan has gone completely unplayable for as long as it has.

It’s time to fix that. 
[h2]New Servers[/h2]
I’ve setup two brand new servers, one UK based and one US based. To maximise geographic exposure, the US server is on the west coast. Both of these servers are using the most up to date version of the database, but note that **progression will not sync between them.** 

You’ll be asked which server you want to play on every time you launch the game. 

[h3]Is this the server rewrite?[/h3]
No. 

I’m close to finishing that off, but I relied on Supabase when I built it and after a 90 day absence they close any active server, providing only a proprietary backup file. This isn’t ideal, and would’ve been very frustrating if we’d have launched just to find the servers shut down. I’m going to look into getting the old database uploaded with a different cloud provider and go from there. This is very low priority for me at the moment though.

[h3]What happened to the 3D version?[/h3]
Still in mind for further work, but don’t expect anything soon. 

[h3]When will the game work on Mac/Linux?[/h3]
It actually already does, but I need time to sit down and figure out exactly how to distribute for these platforms. I messed it up initially, and was too lazy to fix it when people started asking why it didn’t work. Rather than botch it again and then inevitably not touch it for 2 years, I’d rather wait until I had sufficient time and motivation to sit down and work it out properly. 

In the meantime, I’ve removed the Mac support flag from the game (as I should’ve done years ago). Sorry everyone.

notes.title: Want to try BrawlQuest in 3D?
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while! Sorry! [b]The servers are currently down for BrawlQuest, but will be returning very soon! Read on to find out why...[/b]

There are a few exciting things happening in the world of BrawlQuest.

[previewyoutube=tksrzEtvSfg;full][/previewyoutube]

First off, there is a 3d demo available now in the Betas tab. Head over to Steam -> Manage Game -> Betas -> 3d demo and you can have a play around. It loads very slow and is very unoptimised but is a little proof of concept for what might be to come at a later date.

Secondly - and following on from that demo - I'm in the process of [i]totally[/i] rewriting the game's server. This will come with a few new features, although no new content for the moment. The good news is that this new server will be considerably easier to develop on, and may prompt me to rewrite some parts of the game client as well. 

Have a play of the 3d demo and[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fs2eGYHhEVY] join our Discord[/url] to get news on the server rewrite.

Cheers,
Tom

notes.content:
A new update is available for BrawlQuest, fixing several bugs.

notes.title: BrawlQuest 1.0.1 Patchnotes
notes.content:
[h2]Rebalancing Ranged Attacks[/h2]
Ranged attacks have been far too overpowered when levelling, and are the only playstyle worth going for in the end-game. To balance this, we're re-introducing damage falloff.

- If an attack is more than 8m away, it will deal 1 damage
- If an attack is more than 4m away, it will ignore INT and deal 1-ATK damage
- If an attack is more than 2m away, it will deal 1-INT + 1-ATK damage
- If an attack is 1m away it will deal ATK + 1-INT damage

This should make playing Mage fairer and make levelling via the kiting of high level mobs less doable.

[h2]Classes at low levels[/h2]
Previously you've been able to visit the Class Enrollment Office and join an Order from Level 1. This remains, but rather than giving you +50 STR/STA/INT it'll now give you +LVL STR/STA/INT. So a Mage at Level 1 will gain +1 INT and +10 INT at Level 10 and so on.

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
- Added a notice on the character selection screen to signify hardcore characters
- Removed Early Acces references

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Greatly increased server power. This should fix some of the "attacks take forever" problems, but a proper US server will be coming shortly
- Fixed an issue that caused mobs to not aggro correctly
- Fixed an issue that caused mobs to not remove tagged players when losing aggro (therefore giving players loot even if they weren't in combat)

notes.title: BrawlQuest 1.0.0
notes.content:
[h2]Full release[/h2]
After a year in early access, I'm happy to release this game out of Early Access. It isn't completely polished, but I've reached a point where I'm content with the engine and the in-game mechanics. I'll be continuing to add content on a regular basis and plugging any glitches as and when they arise. 

[h2]Content[/h2]
- Opened up the Foglands: a level 8-15 area with 2 new mob types

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Removed the Premium requirement from all actions. The game is now completely free-to-play
- Reduced world draw distance as a temporary fix for framerate drops
- Added a fade out effect to world tiles on the edge of the draw distance
- Fixed a crash when left clicking on an item in your hotbar (thanks Glacier!)
- Fixed a crash when talking to the Bartender in Squall's End (thanks Veesus!)
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies to never aggro (thanks BipBap!)
- Closed off barrel zones

notes.title: Early Access 1.5.0
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3]Hardcore Mode[/h3]
- You can now enable Hardcore mode when creating a character
- Hardcore characters cannot be revived

[h3]Fishing[/h3]
- Fishing Rods can be crafted at an anvil
- Water now has a chance to spawn a fishing spot on it (fishing spots will automatically despawn after a while)
- Using the fishing rod at the fishing spot will reduce its HP like any other resource node
- Destroying a fishing spot will drop 1-5x Pear, and has a 1 in 100 chance of spawning ANY random item from the entire game (ANY ITEM)

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[h3]Character Wipe[/h3]
- All characters have been wiped
- This has been done as the game's balance has evolved a lot over early access, and as we prepare to move away from Early Access and into Full Release we wanted to have a fresh start
- Old characters have been preserved

[h3]Premium[/h3]
- As a free to play game, the time has come to move forward with our plans for a subscription system
- Classes, Enchanting, Building & Pets are now locked to non-premium players
- Added a "Purchase Premium" UI panel that is displayed when attempting to perform a Premium-only action as a non-Premium player
- Added the ability to purchase premium game time from the Steam store (30 days costs £3.99)

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
- Added SFX to various enemies that previously didn’t have them
- Rebalanced the ATK, HP & XP of every single enemy in the game
- Removed 2 Pumpkins left over from the Halloween event

[h3]Items[/h3]
- Squall's End Brew now restores 5 HP (previously it took away 10 HP)
- Boat now moves at 2m/s (previously 1.5m/s)
- Pirate Boat now moves at 3m/s (previously 2m/s)
- Fixed a capitalisation issue with Boat and Pirate Boat
- All mounts other than Horse now move at 4.5m/s (previously variable based on rarity)
- Rebalanced values on all weapons & armour
- Greatly reduced the amount variance on all loot drops relating to Gold

[h3]General[/h3]
- Increased tick rate to 2 (the world still updates once a second, but the server can take inputs twice as fast)
- Rewritten world drawing system to greatly boost frame rates & stability (no more stuttering when moving fast! Woo-hoo! Also animated water! Woo-hoo!)
- Hotbars now save server-side & will no longer clear between game sessions
- Moved to a new server
- Switched some fonts away from non-free fonts

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a stuttering issue when casting a ranged spell
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies to not flash red when hit if SFX volume was set to 0
- Fixed an issue that caused resource nodes to aggro onto players when hit, then spontaneously combust
- Every character will no longer appear when the server restarts

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- Some players are unable to load the crafting catalogue
- Enemies are unintentionally giving double XP
- You currently cannot earn achievements

notes.title: Early Access 1.4.3 Patchnotes
notes.content:
A new version of BrawlQuest is now live with the following changes.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Removed Halloween event (you will still be able to purchase Halloween items until Sunday 7th November)
- Greatly increased the XP given by all mobs, balanced to ensure that stronger mobs always give greater XP than weaker mobs (no more farming Grey Wolves endlessly!)
- Removed RNG from damage spells to match 1.4.2's melee changes
- Old World Crystals are no longer effected by double drops via luck spells or happy hour
- You will now be dismounted when taking damage

[h3]Items[/h3]
- Hero's Blade is a now a +140 weapon (previously +100)
- Pumpkin Head / Slasher Jacket / Slasher Pants no longer give bonus stamina (this was unintended)
- Scroll of Good Fortune is no longer a High Mastery spell and can be used by all classes
- Poison Dagger & Bandit's Blade are no longer Medium weapons and can be held by all classes
- Increased Fire Cloud's drop chance to 10%

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed the Oozing Bone Juice mount's sprite not displaying
- Fixed character stat tooltips to accurately reflect their impact on the game
- Fixed character hub's mislabelling of "STA" as "DEF"
- Fixed an issue that caused a crash when using Scroll of Protection
- Fixed an issue that caused Scroll of Protection's aura to be opaque
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies to not aggro from melee damage alone

notes.title: Early Access 1.4.2b Hotfix Patchnotes
notes.content:
A new update is now live! The focus of this update was to fix a few crashes, but we've also made some balance changes to all 3 classes.

[h2]Mage Buff[/h2]
It's super fun to run around as a Mage firing off shots, but when playing solo it feels really nasty to run out of mana. While this is a necessary balance issue as Mages can totally avoid taking damage until this point, it makes sense to delay it a little and make it feel less like you're waiting around for your mana to restore. This small stat change will allow you to fire off shots more regularly when low on mana, taking away some of that boredom.

- Ranged attacks now require 3 mana (previously 5)

Mage is the only play style that has action-oriented combat. As BrawlQuest runs at only 1 tick, it can feel a little odd when you fire a shot if there's even a small amount of lag. Increasing the range of a staff's blast will make this situation less frequent.

- Increased radius of ranged attacks to 3 meters (previously 2 meters)

[h2]Melee Buff[/h2]
We're not just buffing Mages! Stoics get to use the best armour and with the addition of the Bone Sword also have a +80 melee weapon, enchant-able up to +110. Warriors - meanwhile - only get to have a +50 STR boost that may be totally diminished if the RNGod is not on your side. So, we're making this pretty huge change to how melee damage is calculated to make Warrior feel more satisfying.

- Removed RNG from melee damage calculations
- Critical hits now deal double weapon damage (previously double STR)

Previously you would deal your weapon's damage plus 1 to STR damage, with a 1 in 5 chance of a critical hit dealing STR*2 damage. Critical hits now instead deal double weapon damage, and the entirety of your STR is taken into account.

Obviously this is usable by both Stoics and Warriors, but this makes the +50 STR gain from being in the Warrior Order more significant.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
- XP now spills over when levelling up rather than being hard set to 0
- Set ambient darkness to a purple hue to match Halloween event login screen


[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Slightly improved framerate when world animations are switched on
- Fixed a crash that would occur when holding up your shield while still spawn invulnerable
- Fixed a crash that would occur when trying to purchase the Bat mount
- Fixed Black Bear mount sprite
- Fixed Black Bear miniboss sprite

notes.title: 1.4.2 Patchnotes & Halloween Event
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

A new update is now available.

[h2]Quest for Candy[/h2]
The world has been plunged into a permanent darkness and demons have seeped through a rift in the fabric of reality. Also, some nice Pumpkin Farmer fellas who feed off the stuff the demons are made out of. Pretty handy, that.

- 2x XP
- Added Pumpkin enemies in various places around the game world. These drop Coveted Candy
- New area: Mr Bones Pumpkin Patch, featuring vendors who will exchange Coveted Candy for new event items
- New headpiece: Pumpkin Helmet
- New headpiece: Slasher Jacket
- New chestpiece: Slasher Leggings
- New mount: Bat (4.375m/s)

This event will end at 4pm BST on November 6th, and all items will no longer be obtainable. So get in there quick!

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
- Increased the XP given by Mystic Being's in Elodine's Gift
- Increased the XP given by Skeletons in the Skeleton King's Lair
- Greatly reduced the HP of the Skeleton King
- Set a cap on the reputation given by any kill to 100
- All quests now give 3x their normal XP 
- All players who earned reputation via boss kills have had each kill reduced to equalling only 100 rep per kill

[h2]UI[/h2]
- Players now fade out as they reach the border of visible space
- Introduced better garbage collection for players outside of your range
- World animations now default to off due to FPS issues (pending investigation)

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue that caused ambient lighting to not work correctly (welcome back, atmosphere!)
- Fixed an issue that prevented spells from casting light sources
- Fixed an issue that caused other Premium players to not have the correct coloured name plates
- Fixed an issue that caused other players to not face the right direction if they moved less than 2 tiles
- Fixed an issue that caused other players to have the wrong nameplates if more than 2 players were online

notes.title: Early Access 1.4.1
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Continuing our weekly updates in week #2 comes 1.4.1. This is a smaller update than last week's and will be supported by a content update coming mid next week. The focus of today's update is getting us launched in Free To Play. Now that we've got all existing users with an endless Premium subscription, we're ready for this change occurring shortly.

[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
- Added Level 5 mini-boss to Westlum

[h4]Reputation[/h4]
Reputation is earn-able at Level 40, and is given as a percentage of the total HP of any mob that is killed. Therefore: tougher mobs give greater reputation. Reputation is currently handled as a regular inventory item as currency. You won't earn any reputation between Levels 1 & 39, even after prestiging. 

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Given all existing accounts 99999 days of Premium membership
- The Skeleton King: greatly reduced HP
- Greatly reduced XP given by Skeletons in the Skeleton King's Lair
- Greatly reduced XP given by Mystic Beings in Elodine's Gift

[h2]UI[/h2]
- Added a name colour effect to Premium players
- Added a blue dot on the mini-map to represent your current position
- Added red dots to the mini-map to represent nearby enemies

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Removed the chat swear filter (you're welcome)
- The "out of mana" SFX will no longer play if you don't have M1 held down
- Greatly improved performance of world animations
- Fixed an issue that caused your Order to be reset on server restart. You'll need to set your order again when you log back in!

notes.title: Early Access 1.4.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello friends![/b]

First off a big apology for our silence over the last few months. Our necessity to halt development for a period was documented over on our Discord but we failed to update the Steam page for the game, and we apologise for that. We'll try and keep all platforms in the loop as much as possible from here on out.

We've now released Early Access v1.4.0 with a host of new updates, including a level cap raise, a new dungeon, classes, new gear and a whole host of bug fixes. We'll be hoping to return to a weekly release cycle from here on out, with a new patch every Friday.

The full changelist is available below. See you in-game!

[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
- Raised Level Cap to 40
- New Dungeon: Castle of the Skeleton King (Bosses: Ooze Monster, Skeleton King)
- New items: Bone Fragment, Green Ooze, Bone Hurting Juice
- New mount: Oozing Bone Juice (5m/s)
- New gear: Master Wizard's Cloak (+30 Head Armour, Light, +25 INT. Best in slot: Mage)
- New weapon: Bone Sword (+80 ATK, Medium, +25 STR, +25 STA. Best in slot: Stoic)
- Added Classes (speak to the Order Advisor in Squall's End!)
- All items now have an associated Subtype that defines which classes can and cannot use them

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Quest giver markers are no longer displayed unless the very next NPC message would give a quest. They didn't work properly before and were confusing, but we also want to move away from steering players towards certain NPCs and ignoring others. Quests should be granted from curiosity while exploring as additional rewards rather than direct objectives

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
- Added a mini-map to the UI
- Added work in progress player model animations. You can press R at any time to enable/disable these. They do not currently display all armour pieces
- Changed login & loot sound effects to be a bit less jarring
- Added a new death sound effect
- Re-enabled environmental audio effects

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Changed the way that Prestige level is displayed to fix the infinite Prestige increase exploit
- Reworked world drawing system to greatly improve loading time and reduce stuttering when v-sync is enabled
- Reworked world loading to no longer redownload the world on every launch
- Loot & XP sounds will no longer judder
- Fixed an issue that caused it to rain in caves
- Fixed an issue that caused footsteps to not play when not mounted
- Fixed a server crash caused by the player timeout system
- Fixed an issue that caused Critters to disappear when moving between zones
- Fixed an issue that caused your attack indicator to flicker when moving fast right after attacking
- Fixed an issue that prevented the XP sound effect from playing the correct tone when flying into the player (previously all XP from a single kill would play the same tone rather than "ticking up" as was intended)
- Fixed drawing of large mobs
- Fixed a rare crash on the login screen when clicking on a character too fast
- Temporarily removed the startup News panel

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
- Some shadows are in the wrong positions
- Some mobs are totally static, ignoring players
- The crafting menu does not load for some users
- Environmental audio effects may cause crashes for some users. If this happens please post about it in the #bugs channel on our Discord with the error message!

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.2 Server Patch
notes.content:
A new update has been issued to the server with the following changes. No client update is necessary.

[h2]Content[/h2]
* New weapon: Hero's Blade (+100 ATK, +10 STR, +10 STA, +10 INT) (craftable)

[h2]General Balance[/h2]
* You now earn 2x XP during happy hour (9pm - 11pm BST)
* Loot drops now reset at 9pm BST in-line with happy hour (as previously intended)
* Loot drop variance now only returns positive numbers (you'll see more consistent double loot from resource nodes)
* You'll no longer get dismounted when being hit unless your HP reaches below 90%
* Weapons can now have attributes (increase STA/INT/STR)
* You can no longer craft Minty
* Poison now inflicts 80dps rather than 10% of your remaining health
* Fixed an issue that caused the Poison affliction to grant players invulnerability

[h2]Mob Behaviour[/h2]
* Mobs now leave aggro if you're more than 6m away from them, or 12m away from their spawn location
* Mobs spawned by other mobs will now automatically despawn after 12 seconds
* Mobs that spawn in other mobs now cancel their spawn if they can't find a suitable non-collidable tile placement (rather than spawning them on a collidable tile)
* You can no longer gain XP or loot from mobs spawned in by other mobs

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.2
notes.content:
A new version is now live with the following changes:


[h2]Balance[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
- Introducing Happy Hour: between 9pm and 11pm server local time (Swordbreak is BST) there is a 50% chance of earning double loot. This stacks with double drops from Luck, so you can potentially earn 4x loot for each kill. The roll is completed for the entire party so you'll all earn the drops at the same time
- Melee attacks now have a 1 in 5 chance of critting for double STR damage
- Items now have subtypes
- Increased speed of Horse mount to 4m/s (previously 3.4m/s)
- Increased level requirement for Exotic Robe to 25 (previously 3) and reduced armour value to 20 (previously 25)
- Reduced chance of rain
- Reduced chance of rain stopping (this means it'll rain less frequently but for longer)
- Removed damage fall-off for staffs. All ranged attacks now deal wep value + (1 to player INT)

[h3]Spells[/h3]
- Recovery no longer takes DEF spells into account
- Hitting an enemy with a spell now aggros that enemy
- Hitting an enemy with a spell now tags you for loot, XP and quest progress
- Scrolls now have an additional tooltip message: "Not consumed on use."

[h3]Dungeon: Elodine's Cult[/h3]
- Increased The Gatekeeper (1st boss, Elodine's Cult)'s HP to 20000 (previously 10000)
- Reduced Crazed Student Simon (2nd boss, Elodine's Cult)'s Mystic Being spawn rate to 12s (previously 4s)
- Reduced Scholar Matthew (3rd boss, Elodine's Cult)'s HP to 100000 (previously 250000)
- Reworked layout of Elodine's Cult
- Added voicelines for Elodine's Cult bosses

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- Updated sprites for Leather Armour, Iron Armour, Guardian's Armour and Hero's Armour

[h2]Polish[/h2]
- Added sounds for breaking Stones, Exotic Stones, Mana Crystals & Trees

[h2]Optimisation[/h2]
- Improved bandwidth usage when multiple players are on the screen at once
- Reworked world drawing to improve FPS and loading times

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue that caused Gather quests to not be checked against a player inventory until a player gained the required item again
- Fixed various world collisions
- Fixed a server crash that would occur when an enemy tries to spawn a mob without a suitable non-collidable location within 5m
- Fixed crafting sfx playing when sfx volume is set to 0 (feedback: Rozo, Finn Panther)
- Fixed player moving whilst talking in chat (feedback: Finn Panther)
- Fixed an issue that prevented staff enchantments from being taken into account when used for a range attack
- Fixed an issue that caused quest text descriptions to flicker in the questing panel  (feedback: AHrEJl and midnight)
- Improved error message when crafting is unable to load. This should help us route out the cause of the issue

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.1+3
notes.content:
We're hard at work preparing for a significant building overhaul next week. In the meantime, here's a small bug fix patch. 

[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
- Added a "news panel" that opens on launch. Currently this just pulls from the Steam Events API, but in the future will provide notice of important bespoke content
- Added a new secret mini-boss
- Added a new secret mount, dropped by the boss

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Enemies no longer drop Easter Eggs (the Bunny suit will still be crafteable for another week)

[h2]General[/h2]
- Inventory is now sorted in order of power
- Added an error message when the crafting catalogue fails to load. This should give us more useful information towards fixing that bug
- Slightly modified the way that the crafting catalogue loads. This may fix the empty catalogue issue some players were experiencing
- Fixed a crash related to creating sound effects

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Set enemy respawn time back down to 120s (a proximity-based system will be created soon)

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
- Added a new achievement: The Slayer (Kill 1000 mobs)
- Fixed an issue that prevented the "Brawl Em' All", "Stay Frosty" achievement from being acquirable (feedback: SickNic)

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.1+2
notes.content:
A new update is now live with the following changes

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
- You can no longer move whilst forging
- Crafting recipes are now refreshed every time the crafting menu is opened (this should fix your error, Zyliart!)
- Improved optimisation for sound effects
- Fixed an issue that caused ghost enemies to persist after being spawned in from a mob and dying off screen
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies to move "back" into their position and explode with gore particles when walking away from them then passing them by later in a session
- Fixed several crashes

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
- Enemies now respawn after 300 seconds (up from 120 seconds). This is to make AFK farming less of a necessity and awards players who farm/mine actively (AFK farming still works well, but is less efficient than active farming)
- Enemies can now only cast Poison when within range

[h2]SERVER[/h2]
- You are no longer granted invincibility when poisoned
- You can now be killed by Poison
- Dying while afflicted with a status effect will now remove the status effect
- Fixed a server crash that would occur when damage fall-off on staffs resulted in a 0 damage spell being cast

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.1+1 (bugfix patch)
notes.content:
A small bugfix patch is now live with the following changes:

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a crash related to loading in audio effects
- Fixed a crash related to settings not saving correctly
- Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the hotbar to not display (this will be moved server-side next update)

[h2]Notes[/h2]

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]The Easter Event is NOW ON[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ob9RH4.png[/img]

Scour the land in hunt of Eggs! Each enemy has a 10% chance of dropping one. Take these Eggs to the crafting Anvil where you can turn 100 of them into one of 3 new +10 Bunny Costume armour pieces.

This event and the Bunny Costume Cosmetic will only run until Friday, April 9th so collect em' while you can!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X7haxk2.png[/img]

[h2]Content[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
- Added a new 3-boss dungeon: Elodine's Cult
- Added a new spell: "Whirlwind" (turns you into a swirling whirlwind of Fire for 4 seconds, during which you move at 10m/s, and knock back nearby enemies causing 30 damage)
- Added a new armour set: Bunny Onesie
- Added a new armour set: Studded Armour (+10 STR)
- Added a new enemy spell: Poison (causes afflicted players to lose 10% HP per second)
- You can now press the interact key at Wells to cleanse any affliction

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Added Wells to Elodine's Gift
- Mystic Beings now apply Poison after 8 seconds

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Increased HP per STA point to +10 (previously +5)
- Staffs now have damage fall-off at range (more info here: https://luven.io/staff-damage-falloff/)
- Staffs are now treated as +1 weapons when used for melee (STR still takes effect as usual)
- You are now granted Invulnerability for 10 seconds after respawning (during this time you will not take damage and you are able to walk through mobs)
- Greatly increased chance of rain
- You can now only earn loot from mobs with > 1000HP once per day (resets 11PM BST)

[h2]UI[/h2]
- Added a loading screen after pressing "Enter World"
- Added attack on mouse down when not holding a staff
- Added support for armour pieces larger than 32x32px
- Added support for sound effects for individual items
- Added player image background to armour images in the hotbar
- The target rectangle no longer shows when not wielding a staff
- Dragging items within the hotbar now swaps their positions
- Dragging items from the hotbar to outside the hotbar removes the item
- Your inventory will no longer open when forging
- Fixed character hub armour image drawing out of order

[h2]Server[/h2]
- Added support for "full body spells" that alter player characters entirely
- Enemies that spawn other enemies will no longer spawn them on collidable tiles

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Horse NPCs are no longer invisible in Carus's camp
- Temporarily removed lighting from spell auras
- Adjusted audio levels for creatures in Elodine's Gift
- Fixed an issue that caused mounts to draw 3 pixels off-position when a character was facing right
- Fixed game crash when using staffs (feedback: Veesus & AV8R)
- Fixed an issue that was preventing enchantments on weapons from having an effect
- Fixed an issue that was preventing enchantments on pickaxes from having variable effects (IE a +30 enchant would deal 25 damage)
- Fixed an issue that prevented you from casting ranged attacks on 5 mana
- Fixed being able to use a staff whilst using centred ui elements
- Fixed an issue that prevented XP sounds from playing

[h2]Notes[/h2]
- Voicing, story work & questing for Elodine's Cult will be done next week. I'm too ill to record these right now! The area may go through something of a revamp, too.

notes.title: Early Access 1.3.0
notes.content:
Our largest ever update is now live with a whole host new content and mechanics. The full changelist is below:

[BALANCE]
- Increased the amount of character points you get at levels 1 - 5
- Increased base movement speed to 2.5m/s (previously 2m/s)
- Greatly reduced passive mana regen
- Greatly increased mob's kiting distance
- Mobs now only regain health after being out of combat for more than 10 seconds
- Added a global 10 second spell cooldown
- Stamina now increases your HP by +5 for each point (down from +15)
- Removed the 1/5 damage limit*

[UI]
- Added zone based ambient lighting
- Added 6 new achievements (What does INT do? // Playing With Fire // Stay Frosty // Strong Foundations // DEDICATION // Enchanted)
- Added directional audio
- Added tooltip information for Walls, Floors and Furniture
- Updated the tutorial screens, text is now centered and is clearer
- You can now click and drag to assign items to the hotbar
- Fixed the ability to enchant a null mount field
- Fixed character hub health meter levels when using enchanted armour with stamina buffs.
- Fixed an issue that caused rubberbanding when moving too fast
- Fixed an issue that caused movement to glitch after death
- Fixed an issue that prevented "The Bigger They Are" achievement from being unlockable
- Removed pressing numbers to assign items to hotbar

[CONTENT - NEW]
- Raised the Level cap to 30
- New zone: Elodine's Gift
- New raid: Elodine's Cult (opens on April 1st!)
- Added INT-based ranged weapons (staffs for now, bows coming later!)
- Added 3 new weapons: Wizard's Walking Staff, Bandit's Staff & Guardian's Staff
- Items can now have associated attributes with increase specific stats separately from enchantments
- Added a "Forging" mechanic: you can now smelt ores at furnaces into bars for crafting

[CONTENT - CHANGES]
- Metal Rock & Exotic Rock now drop Metal Ore and Exotic Material Ore respectively instead of smelted bars
- Mages Robe now grants +10 INT
- Bandit's Cloak now grants +10 STR

[ENCHANTMENT]
- You must now be Level 30 to enchant an item
- You can now enchant items lower than the current max echantment losing only the additional levels (IE, to enchant a +25 to +30 you lose 5 levels rather than all 29)
- You can now select how much of a stat you want to apply to an item (from +25 to +30)

[WORLD EFFECTS]
- Added a new world effect: Critters
- Added critters Chickens, Bugs, Mystics and Shades.
- Added a new world effect: Weather
- Added rain and clear skies
- Added a new world effect: Positional Ambient Audio
- Added positional ambient audio for water, trees, anvils, lava and campfires

[MOBS]
- Added SFX for Phoenix & Fire Phoenix
- Reduced the amount of XP given by Phoenix & Corrupted Steed

[SERVER]
- Added support for enemies that take up multiple tiles
- Added support for variable enchantment values
- Fixed an issue that prevented quests and NPC conversation states from clearing when prestiging
- Fixed an issue that allowed you to set your character stats negative (feedback: ThePentinentOne)
- Fixed an issue that caused STR enchantments to not apply correctly

[NOTES]
- You can't currently see when other players use ranged weapons
- Ambient lighting resets in the Foundation Forest portion of Elodine's Gift
- We've added "NOTE: Riverbridge will be accessible in a future update" to the description text for quest "The Apprentice Pt V"
- The raid opens on April 1st. This will mark a move away from our current armour tiers towards more varied and interesting armour sets. The elements for this loot change are in place in this update with a few items getting minor stat buffs.

notes.title: Early Access 1.2.1

[UI]

- Fixed an issue that caused inventory to break on small resolutions
- Fixed the second enchanting phase panel not centering correctly on smaller displays

[ACHIEVEMENTS]

- Fixed an issue that prevented the Need For Steed, Brawl Em' All, Level 2, Level 10 and Level 25 achievements from being attainable
- Temporarily disabled the Kill 1000 Mobs achievement

[SERVER]
- Upgraded resources by 4x*
- Added an automated server restart system
- Fixed an issue that caused Mana & HP Regen to not set properly after a tactical combat retreat*

- Fixed a visual glitch where newly acquired items would display the Enchanted effect (despite not having an enchantment)*


* = patched live, so these changes have already been present for a few days

notes.title: Early Access 1.1.5
notes.content:
A new update is now available for BrawlQuest. We've really focused in on crashes and other performance issues that were preventing people from being able to play the game as intended. There's still work to do but hopefully this'll greatly improve your experience if you've been having trouble.

[GENERAL]
- Greatly improved rubber banding 
- Reworked world creation to use multiple canvasses rather than 1 big canvas. This will allow the game to be played on older GPUs where before it would crash
- Fixed various client crashes (thank you for all the feedback and patience!)
- Improved paths to more consistently offer a speed boost 

[UI]
- Fixed a graphical glitch that was showing the quest panel header when you didn't have any quests
- Items are now cleared from crafting when closed

[SERVER]
- Fixed various server crashes
- Fixed an issue that only caused mobs to regain aggro when on full health (this is what was causing bosses to regain their health when their first target died)

notes.title: 1.1.4 Crash Fix
notes.content: A crash that was affecting some users on 1.1.4 has now been fixed an update has been pushed live. This is for the "attempt to index global 'v' (a nil value)" error.

notes.title: Early Access 1.1.4
notes.content:
A new version of the game is now live with the following changes:

[GENERAL]
- Double drops from Luck spells now affect all player loot equally (previously it was calculated per player so some players would get double drops and some wouldn't) (feedback: Roccandil)
- The lower limit on earning XP from mobs is now 1 (previously 3: this will mean that more mobs give you XP than before)
- Enemies that won't give you XP now highlight gray when aggro'd to you
- You can no longer be affected by more than 1 INT spell at a time (the highest value radius spell is used)
- You're now "tagged" for loot and XP if you're marked as being in combat with an enemy (this means that spells and support roles now earn XP and loot without having to melee hit the target)
- You now restore 10% HP per second when out of combat (rather than +10 HP per second)
- Fixed an issue that prevented the Frost Cloud Mount from drawing (feedback: Klekotnik)

[UI]
- Added tooltips to settings options
- Added item amounts to the hotbar (this will be reworked with the API soon to ensure that consumed items aren't on the hotbar)
- Re-added players online text in the top right
- Fixed the chat box backing
- You can now toggle chat by clicking on the chatbox

[SERVER]
- Improved security
- Greatly reduced teleportation sensitivity (this should help with the rubber banding issue some users are experiencing)
- Resource nodes are no longer caught in chain aggro (feedback: Roccandil)
- Fixed an issue that prevented players from dying within 24m of a headstone
- Fixed an issue which was causing idle player updates to spam console logs
- Fixed a server crash caused by idle players
- Fixed an issue where Luck drop percentage worked inverse (IE 1% had a higher chance of double drops than 100%) (feedback: Klekotnik)
- Fixed an issue that was causing people on slower connections to not be able to launch the game (thank you Rilansis!)

notes.title: Early Access is here!
notes.content:
What a long, strange trip it's been.

I started BrawlQuest in 2017 in my first year of University. It went through so many different iterations, rewrites and design changes that people would constantly be asking me "When is BrawlQuest releasing?" as a bit of an inside joke.

Well, bizarrely and excitingly here it is. 4 years on. Finally. BrawlQuest: Early Access. An MMORPG created by a team of 2.

Right now, there's a lot of stuff you can do in the game:
[list]
[*] Level from 1 - 25
[*] Earn gear / loot
[*] Harvest resources and craft items
[*] Find rare mounts including BOATS
[*] Fight against bosses
[*] Completely quests for kind-hearted (although sometimes murderous) NPCs
[*] Explore a pretty large world
[/list]

This is just the start. We'll be aiming to add in new content weekly and major features as fast as we can design and implement them. There's still some work to be done on the world and many more quests to be added, but we're extremely excited to dig into feedback both positive and negative.

We hope that you'll be joining us on this journey and experience BrawlQuest as it grows. Thank you!

Tom

notes.title: Closed Beta 1.1 Changelist
notes.content:
A new update is now available for the Closed Beta, adding a variety of new features and inclusions. Among these is the addition of questing, our final "core" feature. There isn't much content yet for this feature and we'll be hoping to release an update on Tuesday that adds a considerable number more (along with new end game content).

[CONTENT - NEW]
- Added Questing (there are currently only 2 quests which serve as samples: both are acquirable by speaking to Bartender Fred. More will be coming very shortly!)

[CONTENT - CHANGES]
- You now gain half the character points for each level you gain (e.g 1 at level 2, 1 at level 3, 5 at level 10, 10 at level 20...)
- Horses now move at 3.4 m/s
- Eagles now move at 4 m/s (up from 3.4 m/s)
- Boats now move at 1.5 m/s (up from 1 m/s)
- Pirate Boats now move at 2 m/s (up from 1 m/s)
- Bartender Fred will now sell you Bear Meat when asked
- Updated the Blacksmith's dialogue to match the current crafting system

[GENERAL - CHANGES]
- Different mounts can now offer different speeds (the "Finn Panther" update ;))
- You now move 40% faster when walking on paths
- Other players with variable speeds now smooth movement correctly
- Items now have an associated level and you can't use items that are a higher level than your character
- Enemies that target you now have a Red outline
- Enemies that target you now draw a line between you and them once a second until they are no longer targetting you
- Added a "path" step sound effect
- We've done a "pass" on every item in the game and updated various values and level requirements

[GENERAL - FIXES]
- Fixed an issue that was causing Buddies to not be visible on other players
- Fixed an issue that caused the Level drop floor to be 9 rather than 10
- Fixed a crash that was occurring at launch for new players
- Fixed a crash that would occur when loading enemy sound effects (this is more of an internal thing as it allows us to store other file types in the SFX folder)
- Fixed an issue that was causing Old World Crystals to not be dropped by any boss
- Character points now scale correctly when losing a level due to death
- You can no longer have negative character points: if you do then your stats will be reset to 1,1,1 on death
- Updated Tutorial text to match current gameplay
- Removed the "HOLD TO ATTACK" tutorial auto trigger
- NPCs will now remember what place they were with you in a conversation
- Blood now only spurts from the player when taking damage
- The amount of blood that spurts from players now reflects the amount of damage taken

[UI]
- Overhauled the font sizes on UI panels for better readability
- Added a new popup for when the player levels up
- Added a Skull image next to enemies that are too powerful for you to fight alone
- Added a Red Glow to the screen when taking damage
- Added a flashing indicator to show you have available character points points
- Added an armour panel to easily see how armour is effecting the player (this opens when hovering over the character panel)
- Fixed crafting not scrolling properly on first launch
- Changed the text in the quests panel to be slightly larger
- Changed zone tile

[SERVER]
- Converted Mounts to output Item objects 
- Fixed an issue that was causing enemy TargetName to not be sent to the client correctly
- Fixed an issue that was preventing Old World Crystal drops to not be cleared.
- Bosses now reset everyday at 11pm (server time)
- Added an "Events" API to pave the way for better player feedback on in-game actions in the future
- We can now alter NPC conversation while the server is running
- If a player within 4m of you is a target then you are now counted as being in combat (this fixes an issue where boss fights were trivial when not solo'd)

[NOTES]
- Temporarily disabled level loss on death
- All character stats have been reset to 1
- Temporarily disabled NPC quest & item giver indicators
- The infinite item bug isn't yet fixed

notes.title: NOTICE: End of Support for 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we're prepping for Beta 1.1 - our biggest update yet - we need to start the transition on the live server. As a result the current Beta - 1.0.6 - will not be playable until the new update is live. Once the game launches we'll set up an appropriate dev server to make this transition smoother in the future. 

Look out for Beta 1.1 heading live later today.

- You now only gain 1 Mana p/s when in combat
- You now gain 15 Mana p/s and 10 HP p/s when out of combat
- All spells now require a Blank Scroll to be crafted
- Scroll of Fire now requires 20x Essence of Corruption to be crafted
- The Vial of Oasis Water now only gives +1 Mana. This is a temporary change until we add in a per-item cooldown system.


[SERVER]
- Fixed an issue that caused the server to require a restart after crafting recipes were updated

notes.title: Closed Beta 1.0.5
notes.content:
[GENERAL]
- You no longer need to hold down an attack key to attack in that direction (you stop attacking when moving UNLESS an attack key is being held)
- Fixed an issue that was causing the Eagle mount to not be visible
- Fixed an issue that was causing aggro lines to not be shown between enemies and the player they were targeting
- Fixed an issue that was allowing players to walk over mobs

[UI]
- Fixed crafting not scrolling in irregular window sizes
- Your inventory will no longer open when entering the crafting window
- The crafting window now resets when closed

[CONTENT - CHANGES]
- Reworked crafting: the chance element is removed and each recipe now only creates 1 item
- Leather armour pieces now have their own unique recipes

[SERVER]
- Reworked the crafting system to ensure that you always get the item you have selected on the crafting menu

notes.title: Closed Beta 1.0.4
notes.content:
[GENERAL]
- Fixed settings clearing on each update
- Fixed an issue that was causing the Horse mount to not show an icon in inventory
- Fly-In XP now accurately represents XP earned

[UI]
- You can now see what you've crafted post-crafting
- You can now see what item a recipe will give you in the crafting menu
- Redesigned Level Indicator

[CONTENT - NEW]
- Added in the Questing UI (questing isn't in yet, but the Quest UI gives you some initial goals to get you started in the game)
- New spell: Scroll of Fire (causes {INT} damage to enemies within a 4m radius for 6 seconds)
- New Shield: Iron Shield (+50)
- New Armour Tier: Guardian's 
- New Weapon: Guardian's Dagger (+20)
- New Weapon: Guardian's Axe (+30)
- New Weapon: Guardian's Blade (+50)
- New Resource type: Exotic Material
- New Resource type: Old World Crystal
- New Resource node type: Exotic Stone
- New Buddy: Earth Elementling
- New Buddy: Scorpion
- New Buddy: Silver Dragonling
- New Enemy: Cave Rat
- New Boss: Exotic Phoenix
- New Mount: Eagle
- Access to the Shieldbreak Mine has now been opened


[CONTENT - CHANGES]
- Enemies that would give less than 3 XP to a player will no longer give any XP (no grinding Level 1 mobs, sorry!)
- Enemies now have a global Alert radius of 4m (previously based on their range)
- Enemies that are alerted will now alert other non-aggro'd enemies in a 2 meter radius
- Reduced Metal Stone's health from 65 to 40
- Metal Stone now has a 100% chance of giving Metal (up from 50%) and always gives 1-2 metal (previously 0-4)
- Metal Stone now has a 50% chance of giving 2 additional Metal 
- Metal Stone now has a 10% chance of giving 5 additional Metal
- Scroll of Good Fortune now covers an 8m radius (up from 4m)
- Scroll of Good Fortune now lasts for 60 seconds (up from 10 seconds)
- Updated the Scroll of Good Fortune icon
- Scroll of Intellect now grants +8 INT (up from 3)
- Scroll of Intellect now lasts for 120 seconds (up from 60 seconds)
- Scroll of Intellect now uses up 90 mana (up from 40)
- Updated the Scroll of Intellect Tooltip to match the item's function
- Lizards found in the Desert have been significantly buffed
- Phoenix's found in the Desert have been significantly buffed

[SERVER]
- Fixed an issue that caused players below Level 10 to lose a level on death
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies that were spawned in by other enemies to not despawn correctly on death (this is what was causing The Wilderness to lag like crazy, sorry! You can go back there now!)
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies that used the Death spell to not despawn
- Fixed an issue that caused enemies to stay in aggro if a player disconnected during combat
- Mobs now regain 10% of their health every second when out of aggro rather than +10 HP every second

notes.title: Closed Beta 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[GENERAL]
- Reworked Luck. Where before it increased your chance of getting rare drops it now gives you a chance of earning 2x a rare luck
- Enemy aggro and death sound effects now take SFX volume into account

[UI]
- Fixed hotbar clearing items when tapped twice in rapid succession
- Lines will now display correctly between enemies and the players they are targetting
- Chat text entry now deletes properly when the backspace key is held
- Players now spurt blood when hit
- Added a Health and Mana bar beneath players so you can easily tell how you and other players are doing at a glance
- Added a character level indicator next to usernames
- Added a vsync setting for high refresh rate displays

[CONTENT]
- Increased the Level cap to 100
- You now lose 10% of your levels on death (read more here: https://luven.io/levels-on-death/)

[SERVER]
- Fixed an issue that was causing Pickaxes to take STR into account when calculating damage
- Fixed an issue that caused tagged players to not clear on Enemy death
- Fixed an issue that was causing Mounts to not be visible on players
- Fixed an issue that was causing mobs to struggle to switch targets when their target went out of range
- Greatly reduced anti-teleportation sensitivity (no more flashing white for no reason)
- Fixed an issue that allowed offline players to be targeted and attacked

notes.title: Beta 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[GENERAL]
- Fixed an issue that caused the Horse mount to now display an image in inventory
- Fixed an issue that caused the second line of items in an inventory category to display too far to the right to be clickable
- Fixed chat scrolling
- Armour drawing now goes Legs -> Chest -> Head, allowing Robes to display properly
- Added an "Online Players" display 
- Your Hotbar will no longer clear when updating the game
- You can now only use 1 item per second
- You can only be affected by 1 LUCK spell aura at a time (highest value is used)
- Added your total defense value to the UI next to your ATK

[CRAFTING]
- Revamped the crafting UI
- Inventory now automatically opens when crafting

[CONTENT]
- The Wilderness has now been opened
- The Level Cap has been raised to 8
- PVP has been enabled in The Wilderness
- New armour tier: Iron
- New weapon: Longsword
- New weapon: Battleaxe
- New weapon: Pickaxe
- New crafting recipes for Iron armour, Longsword & Pickaxe
- Items with "Pickaxe" in their title will now harvest resources at the rate of their value (rather than 1)
- Added a walkway between Carus' camp and the rest of Westlum to avoid being trapped by Corrupt Horses
- All Anvils can now be used for crafting (previously only the one in Squall's End worked)

[SERVER]
- Players will now leave the world after 10 seconds of inactivity (down from 120 seconds)
- Fixed a crash when 2 or more AOE spells ended their effects at the same time
- Added an "All Crafts" endpoint for getting a list of every craft possible
- Player position now saves correctly (no more teleporting back to Squall's End after each update)

notes.title: Closed Beta 1.0.1 Hotfix Patch
notes.content:
[GENERAL]
- Added additional UI scaling factors (1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2.5) (feedback: ThinkSometimes)
- Damage indicators will now spawn above enemy health bars (feedback: ThinkSometimes)
- Enemy health bars are no longer partially transparent
- Health bars for resource nodes are now always visible (making it more obvious which tiles are nodes and which aren't)
- Health bars for resource nodes are now blue (making it easier to distinguish between enemies and nodes)
- Potentially fixed an issue that was causing players outside of GMT to not be able to speak
- Passive mana regen is now +5/s (up from +2/s)
- Passive HP regen is now +3/s (up from +1/s)
- Passive mana & HP regen is no longer dependent on whether or not you are being targeted by an enemy
- Fixed a crash when attempt to talk to NPCs who had no dialogue (feedback: Survivor, Frankie)
- Fixed a crash that occurred if the npc dialogue window opened before content had finished loading
- Fixed a crash that occurred when trying to login with an empty username or password

[INVENTORY]
- Player model mannequins are now semi-transparent
- Shield and Leg Armour tooltips will now correctly show the item type and the armour value they provide

[CRAFTING]
- You can no longer add more of an item than you actually have in your inventory to the crafting bench
- You can now only add reagents to the crafting bench (if you lost your horse to this bug I'm real sorry!)
- Item images that haven't previously been loaded are now loaded correctly when appearing for the first time as a crafting result
- Fixed a crash that would sometimes occur when adding items from your inventory to the crafting bench

[CONTENT]
- Re-added the Level 3 Bear enemy
- Made night 20% less dark
- Wolves now have an 85% chance of dropping a Pelt (up from 30%)
- Scroll of Healing is now a 100% craft chance with 1x Scroll of Intellect, 10x Mana Crystal 
- Fixed a graveyard teleport that was in an out of bounds area (feedback: Rozo)

[STUFF WE'RE AWARE OF]
- You can get infinite items from NPCs. Feel free to abuse this bug for now. Gold isn't too useful and the Healing spell is better than food. It'll be patched soon but is low priority right now!

notes.title: The BrawlQuest Closed Beta
notes.content:
We're extremely happy to announce that the BrawlQuest Clsoed beta is NOW LIVE. We've distributed keys to those that registered interest and will be monitoring the game closely. More opportunities to get access to this beta are on the horizon and full launch is expected for the end of this month.

Please let us know your thoughts and any issues you encounter on the Steam Community forums.

Many thanks,
Tom

notes.title: Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32864568/d1f9d102d88a30486107a3a67b22c79bf0e0bc07.png[/img]

Hello!

Pleased to announce that BrawlQuest is now on Steam. It isn't yet publicly available to purchase and won't be until the Beta starts on October 1st, but active players of Alpha can request a key and take advantage of Steam's auto update feature.

This will make pushing updates and keeping track of players significantly easier and for now also spells the end of the character profile service on eu.brawlquest.com.

We're working to make a revamped version of that system that will debut shortly after the Beta has launched.

For now, thanks for playing and welcome to the beginning of the future! 

Sincerely,
Pebsie
